speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my clinic. I understand you are experiencing episodes of cough and shortness of breath; to help me determine the cause, can you describe exactly what triggers these episodes and how long they last?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (likely post-viral induction).

The patient reports nonproductive cough and dyspnea worsening with exertion and at night, following a viral illness 8 weeks ago. Do you have a history of allergic rhinitis, eczema, or other allergic conditions?
